data.one_liner: Lint rules for Dart and Flutter used internally at netglade
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of custom lint rules and Dart Code Metrics configurations to enforce code quality and style guidelines in Dart and Flutter projects.
use_when: You want to enforce a consistent coding style across a team
You need custom lint rules beyond the default linter set
You want to integrate Dart Code Metrics for additional static analysis
avoid_when: You prefer to use only the default linter rules
You need a different static analysis tool that conflicts with these rules
strengths: Extensive rule set tailored to netglade’s standards
Supports Dart Code Metrics for deeper analysis
weaknesses: Only available for Dart/Flutter, not for other languages
Requires adding a dev dependency and updating analysis options
May conflict with other custom lint configurations
data.setup_notes: Add as dev_dependency and include lints.yaml in analysis_options.yaml; optionally extend dcm.yaml for Dart Code Metrics
data.minimal_example:
```yaml
# pubspec.yaml
dev_dependencies:
  netglade_analysis: ^24.0.0

# analysis_options.yaml
include: package:netglade_analysis/lints.yaml
```
